projectNote: A company becomes research-ready only by passing each gate in sequence. A product announcement, a single traffic proxy, or a current price target cannot skip a gate.

gates.title: Macro trend
gates.question: Do independent, comparable sources show action-oriented machine activity accelerating?
gates.definition: Classify a trend only after at least three comparable observations. Treat source disagreement as research, not an average.
gates.currentRead: Cloudflare and MCP automated histories each begin with one observation; the remaining signals are periodic source baselines.

gates.title: Causal mechanism
gates.question: Would more agentic activity mechanically create a scarce, billable resource for the company?
gates.definition: Name the billable unit, agentic trigger, price architecture, incremental cost, and the condition that would prove or break the mechanism.
gates.currentRead: The four core candidates now have a structured mechanism map; product relevance is not counted as monetization.

gates.title: Company capture
gates.question: Is the company reporting the revenue quality, margin, retention, or cash-flow evidence implied by the mechanism?
gates.definition: Use dated, company-reported KPIs and retain contrary evidence. Require an agent-specific or clearly causal commercial signal before upgrading the state.
gates.currentRead: Akamai, Elastic, Dynatrace, and F5 have plausible routes and dated evidence, but none reports agent-specific revenue or economics.

gates.title: Expectation alignment
gates.question: Are fiscal-period-aligned estimates and valuation history moving more slowly than operating evidence?
gates.definition: A genuine expectation-gap call needs fiscal alignment, explicit accounting convention, and at least two point-in-time consensus and valuation observations.
gates.currentRead: The daily Eulerpool view supplies current context. Only Akamai aligns to the displayed annual period, and no provider-backed revision or multiple history is retained.

gates.title: Scenario model
gates.question: What operating and cash-flow path must occur for the market to be right, wrong, or indifferent?
gates.definition: Keep reported facts, consensus, and our assumptions separate. Use scenarios to expose the required economics, not to manufacture a price target.
gates.currentRead: The first transparent assumption lab is Akamai; other core candidates remain unmodeled until their capture and market-data gates improve.
